# Release watcher: technical specification

Version 1.0.0 of the specification: 17 tests and 1 environment. The chapters follow arc42, and a chapter with nothing in the specification is left out.

## 1. Introduction and goals

## 6. Runtime view

### Job sweep

Looks for a new release and installs it.

Runs every PT1M, as the role installer. Running it twice over the same records changes nothing a second time.

### Job prune

Removes releases older than the last three.

Runs on the schedule `0 3 * * *` (UTC), as the role installer. Running it twice over the same records changes nothing a second time.

### Process releaseWatcher

Asks the registry for a new release of each service and installs it.

Runs always, from the host's start; started and watched by the service manager, acting as no role. Runs the jobs sweep. Reads the settings registryAddress and registryToken when it starts. On SIGTERM: finishes the release it is installing, then exits 0, within PT30S; on SIGHUP: reads its settings again. Exits 0 when it was asked to stop; 78 when a setting is wrong. Started again: when it fails, after PT5S; given up after 5 starts within PT10M. Never started again after exit 78. Healthy when it has asked the registry within the last two minutes. Watched by watcher-running.

### Process pruner

Prunes old releases at night.

Runs when a job it runs is due; started and watched by the service manager, acting as no role. Runs the jobs prune. Started again: never.

### Process diskReport

Writes how much disk the releases take.

Runs every PT6H; started and watched by the service manager, acting as no role. Started again: not said.

## 10. Quality requirements

The design tests: what must hold on every implementation. Golden scenarios succeed; red scenarios are refused.

| Test | Subject | Level | Scenario | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| release-watcher-succeeds | process releaseWatcher | system | golden | its settings are valid | the process releaseWatcher starts | it is healthy: it has asked the registry within the last two minutes |
| release-watcher-signal-sigterm | process releaseWatcher | system | golden | the process releaseWatcher is running | it receives SIGTERM | it finishes the release it is installing, then exits 0, within PT30S |
| release-watcher-setting-invalid-registry-address | process releaseWatcher | system | red | the setting registryAddress is not a URI | the process releaseWatcher starts | it exits 78 before it does any work, naming registryAddress |
| release-watcher-secret-missing-registry-token | process releaseWatcher | system | red | the secret registryToken is missing | the process releaseWatcher starts | it exits 78 before it does any work, naming registryToken |
| release-watcher-exit-78 | process releaseWatcher | system | red | a setting is wrong | the process releaseWatcher ends | it exits 78 and is not started again |
| release-watcher-restarted-after-a-crash | process releaseWatcher | system | red | the process releaseWatcher is running | it ends with a status other than 0 | the service manager starts it again after PT5S |
| release-watcher-crash-loop-given-up | process releaseWatcher | system | red | the process releaseWatcher fails each time it starts | it has been started 5 times within PT10M | the service manager does not start it again, and the monitor watcher-running alerts |
| pruner-succeeds | process pruner | system | golden | ... | the process pruner is started when a job it runs is due | it does its work and exits 0 |
| disk-report-succeeds | process diskReport | system | golden | ... | the process diskReport is started, every PT6H | it does its work and exits 0 |
| sweep-succeeds | job sweep | system | golden | a new release is in the registry | the job sweep runs | it installs it |
| sweep-runs-twice | job sweep | system | golden | the job sweep has run | it runs again over the same records | nothing changes a second time |
| prune-succeeds | job prune | system | golden | four releases are kept | the job prune runs | the oldest is removed |
| prune-runs-twice | job prune | system | golden | the job prune has run | it runs again over the same records | nothing changes a second time |
| sweep-registry-down | job sweep | system | red | the registry does not answer | the job sweep runs | it installs nothing and tries again on its next run |
| prune-in-use | job prune | system | red | the oldest release is still running | the job prune runs | it keeps that release |
| pruner-fails | process pruner | system | red | the disk is read-only | the process pruner is started when a job it runs is due | it exits with a status other than 0 and is not started again |
| disk-report-fails | process diskReport | system | red | the folder of releases is missing | the process diskReport is started, every PT6H | it exits with a status other than 0 |
